info.album: Take Off Your Pants And Jacket

podcast.body: The music video for this song, from the 2001 album Take Off Your Pants and Jacket, notably featured a Dodge van from the 1980s. This van later disappeared after the video shoot. "Still with Blink 1.2, let's go back to the video for the song The Rock Show from the Take Off Your Pants and Jacket Album in 2001."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Written by Mark Hoppus in about 10 minutes as a deliberate "F you" to the record label, who were pressuring the band for a commercial hit. Intended as a cheesy, disposable pop punk song, it unexpectedly became the album's first single and a major hit, backfiring on Mark's intention. The song refers to the real-life club Soma in San Diego. "The Rock Show from Blink 182 written in 10 minutes and intended as an F you to the record label, which kind of backfired, but in a good way, I guess."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Rise of Blink 182 Part 2

podcast.body: This song is mentioned as an example of Blink-182's work, a band that greatly benefited from Warped Tour exposure. "There's Blink 182 and the Rock Show."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
